actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic identity (broad suppression of oxidative/lipid metabolic programs, FDR q=0.001). Membership representation is conflicting (WXS strongly positive, CT/RNA/WSI non-positive), but the relevant boundaries are positively supported: the K7_C0001|K7_C0004 boundary shows a represented current boundary (spectral ARI 0.758, within 0.431 > between 0.178) and the K7_C0001|K7_C0007 boundary shows strong representation (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 > between 0.172). No supported split or merge was identified, and no measured technical explanation was raised. The candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic identity (immune-low, oxidative-metabolism-high; FDR q<=0.0014). Membership representation is non-positive across all four native views, but the relevant boundaries are positively supported: K7_C0002|K7_C0003 shows a represented current boundary (ARI 1.0, within 0.396 > between 0.176), K7_C0002|K7_C0005 shows strong representation (ARI 1.0, within 0.434 > between 0.113, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure), and K7_C0002|K7_C0004 shows moderate representation (ARI 0.772, within 0.378 > between 0.121). No supported split or merge was identified and no measured technical explanation was raised, so the candidate remains a defensible independent unit.
